description: Claim accrued AERO from a gauge. getReward credits its account argument rather than the sender, so a claim can pay a different address than the one paying gas; the plan states which. A claim with nothing earned succeeds and transfers nothing.

account.description: Account whose emissions are claimed; defaults to sender. getReward credits this address, so a non-sender value pays someone else.

gauge.description: Gauge from a Sugar pools read (address)
